test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are the characteristic(s) of Monopoly market?

(i) There is a single producer of a particular commodity.

(ii) No other commodity works as a substitute for this commodity.

(iii) There are no restrictions to prevent any other firm from entering the market and to start selling the same commodity.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__Only i and ii__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Monopoly:**
 
• Characteristics associated with a monopoly market make the** single seller the market controller as well as the price maker. **
 
• There are **restrictions to prevent any other firm from entering** the market and to start selling the same commodity. 
 
• A monopoly refers to a market situation in which **there is only one seller with many buyers of a commodity.**
 
• He enjoys the **power of setting the price** for his goods. 
 
• No other commodity works as a substitute for this commodity.
